metadata.chapter_subtitle: How nitrogen availability controls productivity and ecosystem function

inventory.summary: The chapter had the right biogeochemical content, but it needed a clearer opening frame so the nitrogen pools and limiting-process logic were established before the kinetics work began.
issues: The chapter needed the same learner-facing entry structure used elsewhere in the revised series.
Readers benefit from a more explicit bridge between nitrogen form, plant availability, and productivity limitation.
The environmental systems topic-library set needed stronger consistency in onboarding.

rewrite.summary: Added clearer chapter-entry scaffolding while preserving the coupled nitrogen-uptake and limitation model.
editor_notes: Added a Before You Start section.
Used the opening to foreground the mineralization-to-uptake chain.
Kept the Michaelis-Menten treatment and worked example intact.

qa_review.summary: The chapter now explains the nitrogen-limitation problem at a fairer pace while maintaining correct kinetics and biogeochemical logic.

repair.summary: The main repair was to improve conceptual pacing and make the uptake-limitation logic easier to enter.
actions_taken: Added a Before You Start section.
Clarified the progression from decomposition to mineral N to plant uptake.
Preserved the kinetic and coupled C-N model content.

design_review.summary: The chapter already uses explainers and examples effectively, and the revised entry improves interpretation of the cycle and uptake relationships.
improvements_made: Retained the chapter's cycle-based explanatory structure and interactive support.
Improved interpretive support around the link between nitrogen supply and NPP.
